jobs.description:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

**What You Will Do. A Glimpse Into Your Role

**As Managing Director Denmark at Global Blue by Shift4, you will oversee one of the company’s leanest but most dynamic organizations, operating in a highly competitive environment centred around Copenhagen and Kastrup Airport refund operations. You will combine strategic leadership with a hands-on operational approach, ensuring excellence in day-to-day activities while driving long-term growth.

You will work closely with your manager to shape and implement the country strategy, while actively engaging with merchants, airport stakeholders, Customs (SKAT) and your internal teams across both Tax Free and Payment, an area expected to become increasingly important in Denmark over the coming months and years. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a versatile position, balancing commercial development, operational oversight and strategic execution within a Nordic market that demands agility, strong relationships and a strong focus on market-share defence.

**Main Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities will span both strategic and operational dimensions, including:

**Strategic & Business Leadership

**

• Develop, implement and execute business strategies to achieve short- and long-term goals.

• Drive market growth by hunting new merchant partnerships in Payment and farming existing relationships in Tax Free Shopping, defending the established market position.

• Prepare business plans to improve cost-efficiency and operational performance.

• Lead strategy reviews and business development initiatives, identifying opportunities in current and new segments.

**Operational & Team Management

**

• Ensure excellence in airport refund operations, coordinating closely with the Refund Manager and refund agents.

• Support and supervise Key Account Managers in merchant management and sales activities, while maintaining hands-on management of your own merchant portfolio.

• Address day-to-day operational issues with merchants, including IT-related matters.

• Manage hiring, terminations, salary reviews and bonus decisions in alignment with line management.

**Stakeholder Management

**

• Maintain strong relationships with business partners, authorities and key stakeholders, including Customs, airports, merchants, tourism associations and government bodies.

• Negotiate with airport authorities on operational contracts and collaborations.

**Governance & Compliance

**

• Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, rules and company policies.

• Provide monthly reports, market insights and strategic advice to upper management.

• Oversee internal and external communications and key business documentation.

**Every action has an impact. You will make a difference here if:

**

• You thrive in a role that combines strategy with operational involvement and are comfortable getting your hands dirty when needed.

• You bring strong leadership, motivating diverse teams and leading by example.

• You can diagnose business issues quickly and take decisive actions when performance deviates from expectations.

• You build trusted relationships with merchants, institutions and partners, acting as the face of Global Blue in Denmark.

• You can manage multiple business functions simultaneously while keeping strategic priorities clear.

• You bring a dynamic and proactive approach to your work.

**Key competencies to empower your journey.

****You’ll Drive Towards Success If

**

• You demonstrate sharp business judgment, strong analytical skills and the ability to work with business intelligence and big data to identify opportunities.

• You are skilled in negotiation, contract management and partnership development.

• You excel in communication and interpersonal relations, both internally and externally.

• You show excellent organizational and leadership capabilities, including crisis management and decision-making under pressure.

• You have solid financial competencies, being able to use dashboards and reporting systems to drive performance.

• You are proficient in MS Office and used to working with ERP, CRM and financial/reporting systems.

• You are agile and able to make quick decisions, particularly in the fast-moving Payment environment.

• Knowledge of the Point of Sale (POS) IT landscape would be an advantage.

• You have a good understanding of the local Danish retail, merchant and Payment ecosystem.

• Fluent English is required.

We foster career growth through internal mobility, embrace an Agile Working Model, and prioritize work-life balance. Committed to sustainability, we focus on creating positive impacts for employees, clients, and communities. Guided by our 5 Ways of Working, we value client satisfaction, collaboration, innovation, and shared success.

Submit applications only through official Global Blue channels. We do not use any third-party services or platforms for recruitment.

Always verify emails or LinkedIn messages. Ensure communications come from official @globalblue.com addresses or certified Global Blue recruiters/employees.

We will never ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone requests this, it is a scam—report it immediately.

Feels like you? Explore further!

Let’s write the future together: apply now!

Follow us on Social Media! Global Blue

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The OTC Supervisor leads the Order-to-Cash team and owns the quality, speed and control of our cash application, collections and reconciliation processes. The role has a special focus on reconciling card payments and delivery platform settlements across a high-volume, multi-location F&B business. You lead and develop the team, safeguard accurate month-end close deliverables, and drive standardisation and automation of OTC processes in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. The role reports to the Global OTC Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**_People and team leadership

_

• Lead, coach and develop the OTC team, plan workload and the close calendar, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery

_Reconciliation and cash application

_

• Own the daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation of card acquirer, payment provider and delivery platform settlements against POS data, bank and the general ledger

• Ensure differences, chargebacks, fees and missing settlements are resolved, including follow-up with external partners

• Ensure correct cash application, customer and franchise/B2B invoicing, collections and aged debt follow-up in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

_Close, control and reporting

_

• Ensure accurate balance sheet reconciliations, specifications and reporting for month-end, quarter-end and year-end close

• Support month-end close through AR and line of credit reconciliations and review of the allowance for doubtful accounts

• Safeguard internal controls and audit readiness, and report KPIs such as unmatched items and days to cash to management

_Process improvement and collaboration

_

• Drive standardisation, harmonisation and automation of OTC processes across markets

• Partner with Store Operations, Treasury, Accounting, IT and payment and delivery partners, and advise the business on OTC topics

• Act as a key member of cross-functional teams to improve the flow of data and reporting

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes

• You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift

• Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• +6 years in Order-to-Cash, accounts receivable or revenue accounting, incl. team lead experience

• Experience from retail, F&B, restaurant or hospitality with many locations

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

• Proven experience reconciling card payments (e.g. Adyen, Nets/Nexi, Worldline) and delivery platforms (e.g. Wolt, Uber Eats, Just Eat) to POS, bank and GL

• Strong accounting, process and Excel skills; degree in finance, accounting or business administration

• Fluent English (Danish is an advantage)

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Employment type: Full-Time

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer for advanced process solutions
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop technical process solutions for customers across the world and play a key role in transforming customer requirements into competitive and reliable industrial systems? Then this could be your next position.

On behalf of Simatek A/S, we are looking for a Process Engineer who will become a central technical resource in the company's Process & Proposal team and contribute to the continued development of customer-specific process solutions for industries worldwide.

About Simatek

Simatek A/S is an international engineering company specializing in air filtration, pneumatic conveying, dust handling, and process solutions for industries such as food, feed, grain, recycling, minerals, and industrial manufacturing. The company designs and delivers customized systems that help customers improve operational efficiency, product quality, environmental performance, and workplace safety. From its headquarters in Albertslund in Denmark, Simatek serves customers around the world and combines strong engineering expertise with a flexible and customer-oriented approach.

The position

As Process & Application Engineer, you will become part of Simatek's international Process & Proposal team with colleagues in both Denmark and India. Focusing primarily on solutions for the food, dairy, feed and grain industries, you will transform customer requirements into technically robust and commercially competitive process solutions.

Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will perform process calculations, size equipment, define system configurations and contribute to the development of tailored solutions that balance technical performance, cost efficiency and customer needs.

Your responsibilities will include

• Develop process solutions based on customer requirements and application data, identifying and solving technical issues in the process design

• Perform process calculations and system sizing for complete process installations

• Prepare and review process documentation

• Collaborate with suppliers regarding technical specifications and equipment selection

• Prepare technical proposals and quotations

• Contribute to the development and standardization of engineering tools, methods and solutions

• Work closely with R&D and the product management team to develop competitive solutions

• Support continuous improvement of process design standards and engineering practices

• Participate in occasional international travel for customer and technical meetings (approx. 20 days per year)

Your profile

We imagine you have a strong engineering background and experience developing process systems or technical solutions within industrial environments.

You likely bring:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree within Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline

• Experience within process engineering, system design or industrial solution development, with the ability to independently drive technical tasks

• Skilled in process calculations, equipment sizing and can read PFD and P&ID drawings

• Experience in preparing technical proposals, quotations or engineering project documentation is an advantage

• Experience from the food and dairy industry will be considered an advantage

• Professional proficiency in English. An additional language will be considered an advantage

As a person, you are analytical, solution-oriented and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You work in a structured manner, take ownership of your tasks and enjoy collaborating across technical and commercial disciplines.

Why join Simatek?

You will join an entrepreneurial organization where the distance from idea to implementation is short, allowing you to make a tangible impact.

The role offers:

• Flexible working conditions including the possibility of working from home, up to two days per week by agreement

• Attractive compensation package including pension scheme, health insurance and performance bonus

• An active social environment and employee association arranging events throughout the year

Interested?

Send your application and CV via the application button. We look forward to hearing from you.

For more information, you are very welcome to contact Senior Business Consultant Erik Bernskov at erik.bernskov@actief-hartmanns.dk or by phone at +45 41 21 13 29. All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

Actief Hartmanns manages the entire recruitment process on behalf of Simatek A/S, and all contact regarding the position should therefore be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion or nationality.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been identified.

jobs.occupation: QMS Professional for CMC Pilots Engineering
jobs.description:
QMS Professional

CMC Pilots Engineering

Location: onsite Bagsværd

**Your impact begins here

**Would you like to work closely with quality, engineering, and projects in a highly collaborative and technically complex environment? We are looking for a QMS Professional to join CMC Pilots Engineering and support quality and compliance activities across the department. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, scientists, technicians, QA, and managers to help ensure quality, structure and coordination of projects.

This role offers broad exposure across the organisation and an opportunity to work with quality processes in a dynamic environment with many stakeholders and ongoing activities. Apply today!

**What You’ll Do

**As QMS Professional in CMC Pilots Engineering, you will support and coordinate quality activities across the department, including follow-up on deviations, CAPAs, audits, and training, while contributing to continuous improvements and alignment across teams. The role combines operational coordination, stakeholder collaboration, and quality support, and suits someone who enjoys working across functions and building strong relationships in the organisation.

**Your Day-to-day Tasks Will Include

**

• Coordinating and facilitating weekly quality board meetings, including follow-up on actions and deadlines

• Supporting handling and follow-up on deviations, CAPAs, and change requests across projects and teams

• Supporting preparation and coordination of audits and inspections together with relevant stakeholders

• Monitoring quality data and supporting visibility on quality-related activities and deadlines

• Collaborating with engineers, scientists, QA, and leaders on GMP and QMS-related topics

• Supporting onboarding and training activities related to deviations, quality processes, and systems

• Contributing to continuous improvements of quality processes and ways of working across the department

You will succeed in this role if you enjoy creating structure, connecting the dots across quality activities and turning data into clear insights that help the organisation focus on what matters most.

**Who You’ll Work With

**CMC Development turns promising molecules into approved products in close collaboration with colleagues across Research & Development and Global Manufacturing & Supply.

CMC Pilots Engineering is part of CMC Pilots and is responsible for engineering activities related to pilot facilities and manufacturing of new drug substance and product candidates. The department consists of more than 70 employees working across projects, validation, and technical development activities.

**What You’ll Bring

**We image that you hold a master’s degree in engineering, biotechnology, chemistry, pharmacy, or similar. You also bring:

• At least 3 years of experience working with GMP and quality processes in a regulated environment

• Hands-on experience with deviations, CAPAs, audits, training coordination, or related QMS activities

• Experience using the Test Information Management System (TIMS), will be considered an advantage

• A structured and proactive approach, and comfort following up on tasks and deadlines

• An interest in quality processes and continuous improvements

Experience from engineering, pilot production, validation, or pharmaceutical development environments will be considered an advantage.

As a person, you take initiative, work proactively, and can handle multiple tasks at once. You enjoy collaborating across teams and working with many stakeholders. You keep an overview in hectic situations, see possibilities, and drive solutions.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across markets. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What We Offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 570,200 to DKK 838,100, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Please apply by 29 November 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Associate Director Anne Krogh Rovik at AERV@novonordisk.com .

While not mandatory, we strongly encourage you to submit a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate to join us in CMC Pilots Engineering. Please do not include a photo in your CV, as this supports a fair and efficient recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**_Do you want to help deliver high-voltage cable projects? Can you take the technical lead from detailed design through procurement, construction and handover? And do you bring an electrical background and experience with high-voltage installations? Then join COWI and put your expertise to work.

_**

**Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**

As our project portfolio grows, so does the need for Technical Leads to support the delivery of high-voltage cable installations. We are looking for a Technical Lead to join COWI.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Compose of concept design, cost estimates, project program timelines etc.

• Develop detailed designs for cable routes, horizontal directional drilling solutions between two or more substations in collaboration with other disciplines in respect to environmental- landowner issues in the project organisation.

• Perform cable ampacity design and electrical studies with standard software applications

• Develop technical requirements for procurement of supply/installation contracts followed up by tender evaluation and contract negotiations

• Participate in external meetings and manage contact with various stakeholders.

• Contribute to substation projects to ensure that cable installations can be routed to the relevant bays.

• Drive technical project delivery and facilitate construction meetings on site.

• Coordinate factory & site testing, quality assurance documentation and handover.

Travel in Denmark in connection with the projects will be part of the role.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You take a proactive, collaborative and solution-oriented approach to your work and are comfortable managing several tasks at the same time.

On top of that, you will have:

• An electrical background, for example as an electrical engineer, Installatør or maskinmester.

• Experience with the establishment of high-voltage installations.

• Relevant experience in driving projects forward.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Pia Alrøe at PIAL@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for assuring the sustainability of our biomass. You’ll have a central role helping our suppliers understand our requirements and the ever-changing regulation as well as making sure we can document and report to our stakeholders including regulators, NGOs, customers and shareholders. You will do this as part of a small team and in close partnership with our colleagues in fuel procurement and logistics.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of Bioenergy Sustainability, where you and your colleagues will work together to ensure best-in-class sustainability assurance. We’re a small team that works transparently and collaborates closely across different areas of expertise. We combine sustainability and supply chain expertise with data-driven insights to support robust assurance, reporting, and decision-making. As a team, we exchange ideas and knowledge and make sure our competencies are used in the best possible way. We travel frequently to cooperate with our suppliers and to stay “updated”.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• engaging with suppliers assuring they meet our sustainability requirements

• advising collegues in fuel procurement and logistic on sustainability matters

• supporting our sustainability certification processes together with the team

• translating complex sustainability data and regulatory requirements into clear insights and practical guidance for suppliers, colleagues, and other stakeholders

• contributing to the continuous improvement of our sustainability processes, data quality, and reporting.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have experience with the forestry sector and the timber supply chain

• preferably have experience with sustainability certification and relevant regulation

• have interest in, data management and basic data analysis

• have a structured and systematic approach to your work, ensuring quality and consistency across data, documentation, and sustainability processes

• have a perseverant nature and are able to stay focused and work in structured way

• have good social skills and cultural understanding to build networks both among suppliers and stakeholders as well as internally in the organisation

• hold a relevant academic background

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

The role includes occasional travel to support collaboration across locations and engagement with key stakeholders.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr44,800.00- kr67,200.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

jobs.occupation: Internship - Research Intern, Speech & Language Processing
jobs.description:
Summary

Please note this internship will be a minimum of three months, you must be enrolled as a student on a PhD course and available to start no later than 1st June 2027

Within Apple’s Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning organization (AIML), you can take part in the ongoing revolution that machine learning plays in daily life. Apple’s fully-integrated hardware and software provide unique opportunities to deliver amazing experiences, all while prioritizing user privacy. As an AIML intern, you will get to explore new methods, apply machine learning to solve ambitious problems, advance state-of-the art technology through research and publications, challenge existing metrics or protocols, and develop new theories that will impact the way we understand machine learning and the experiences it can enable. Come collaborate with some of the best in the business and help build the world's most innovative products and experiences.

Description

In an AIML internship, you will collaborate with researchers, engineers, and program/project managers to tackle innovative challenges. You will also receive technical mentorship and guidance that allows you to learn new things every day, gain practical skills, build real world experience, develop a greater understanding of our industry, and form valuable connections. Together, you and your team will partner to design and implement an innovative solution for a Machine Learning problem that is meaningful. At the end of your internship, you will have the opportunity to meet and present your work to AIML leadership. Where appropriate, you will have the opportunity to submit your work for publication at a suitable conference.

We are offering a research internship opportunity to work directly with our research team in Copenhagen, Denmark on projects ranging from multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) to multilingual speech language models (SpeechLMs). The internship topic can be fitted to the candidate's interests, with example topics including language interference and cross-lingual transfer, the effect of training data composition on multilingual generalization, low-resource languages and dialects, efficient adaptation and continual learning, self-supervised and multimodal learning, and interpretability of multilingual speech models.

Minimum Qualifications

• Working towards a doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, data science, applied mathematics, cognitive science, computational linguistics or equivalent.

• In-depth knowledge of deep learning and statistical machine learning, with strong Python programming skills and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Research experience in multilingual or cross-lingual speech and language processing, such as ASR, speech LMs, or audio language models

• Interest in Speech and Language Processing

• Strong demonstrable record of publishing academic research in ML-related peer-reviewed venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML...), including language- and speech-specific ones (e.g. *ACL, Interspeech, ICASSP)

• Ability to collaborate with others and to deliver ML technologies aligned with Apple's core values: the highest standards of quality, scientific rigour, innovation, and respect for user privacy

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience training or fine-tuning large speech or language models

• Experience with language interference, cross-lingual transfer, or low-resource languages and dialects

• Interest in the interpretability and efficient adaptation of speech models

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant – Technical and Business Data Administration
jobs.description:
Student Assistant – Technical and Business Data Administration
