jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Cyber security
• Privacy engineering
• Computer Systems
• Edge/cloud computing
• High-Performance Computing (HPC)
• Data Engineering
• Big Data Infrastructure
• Machine Learning Systems
The main tasks and responsibilities include:

• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment
Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-track
When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Evaluation and promotion proces:

• Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
• A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
• A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
• Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship 
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
• References/recommendations 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Logistics Developer

Help shape the future of logistics through data, technology, and projects

Would you like to help develop one of Denmark’s largest retail supply chains? Whether your strengths lie in data and analytics or in moving projects forward, you could be our new colleague in Logistics Development & Support.

The team

You will join a team of experienced specialists and project managers working to continuously improve Salling Group’s supply chain and logistics operations.

We work closely together, challenge existing ways of working, and combine analytical thinking with a strong focus on execution. You will work closely with stakeholders across Supply Chain & Logistics and collaborate with other business units such as Tech, Bilka, føtex, and Netto.

The role

You will help improve logistics operations and support strategic decision-making, taking ownership of your own analyses, projects, and recommendations in line with your experience.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Identifying and driving logistics and supply chain improvements

• Analysing data and translating findings into actionable recommendations

• Developing business cases and management presentations

• Supporting or leading cross-functional projects, depending on your experience

• Contributing to digitalisation, automation, and process optimisation

Depending on your strengths, your focus may be on data and analytics or project delivery:

Data and analytics: You enjoy exploring data, solving complex problems, and translating findings into clear recommendations. You have strong competences in Excel and experience with programming in VBA, Python or similar. Experience with data visualization is an advantage”

Project delivery: You enjoy structuring tasks, collaborating with stakeholders, and moving improvements forward. You use data and analyses to support decisions and implementation.

You do not need to cover both areas. We are interested in the strengths you can bring to the team.

Your profile

You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant experience. You hold a Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Economics, Business Intelligence, or a related field.

You approach problems analytically, take ownership of your tasks, and enjoy working with different stakeholders. You are curious about technology, digitalisation, and AI, and communicate confidently in Danish and English.

What we offer

You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside experienced colleagues on strategic and business-critical supply chain initiatives. The role offers a steep learning curve and opportunities to develop within analytics, logistics development, or project leadership.

We offer a competitive salary and benefits, including employee discounts across Salling Group.

Interested?

We would love to hear from you and learn where you see your strongest contribution.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible and no later than 1 December.

For further information, please contact:

Louise Grøn

Head of Logistics Development & Support

+45 2818 2592

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our team as Finance Business Partner.

**Be part of the movement – and play your part

****About The Role

**DFDS operates through two divisions – Logistics and Ferry. In this role, you will join the central Business Finance team for the Logistics Division and take part in how financial performance is measured, steered, and improved across a rapidly growing European logistics business. You will report to the Head of Central Business Finance Logistics, who reports to the Divisional CFO Logistics.

The central Business Finance team holds ownership of all core financial planning, reporting, functional finance, and commercial support activities of the Logistics Division. You will join a team of four Finance Business Partners in Copenhagen and two Business Analysts in our Shared Service Center in Poznan.

**Within The Team, You Will Take Responsibilities In

**

• Driving the divisional monthly- and quarterly performance cycle, incl. reporting and budgeting

• Driving improvement initiatives for the reporting framework, automation and data quality

• Engaging in improvement initiatives in the data models, and planning frameworks relevant to the performance cycle

• Supporting the adoption of new KPI frameworks and models for risk assessment to the performance outlook

• Supporting financial insight and decision material to senior stakeholders in central functions

• Financial processes, data models and analytical tooling incl. usage of EPM, BI and AI tools

Further, you will work closely with the Group FP&A team and the Senior Finance Business Partners across business units to ensure aligned financial processes, shared standards, and timely reporting.

Your role will be hands on, performing reporting- and analytical activities, together with a team that sits at the centre of the division’s performance agenda.

You will be based at our headquarters in Copenhagen and join a driven and dedicated Business Finance team where colleagues work closely together, support each other, and take pride in driving clarity and impact for the business. The division has more than tripled in size in recent years, and the business finance function is at the core of driving performance in this setting.

**About You

**You thrive in a role that combines the recurrent periodic reporting activities with hands-on analytical work, contributing to the strategic direction for the division. With this in mind, we imagine that the ideal candidate brings:

• +2 years of experience within FP&A or Business Finance, preferably from large, international, or complex organisations

• Understanding of financial processes, planning cycles, P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

• Strong analytical skills and structured problem solving abilities

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• A collaborative mindset and strong personal drive

• Fundamental understanding of EPM or ERP systems (e.g., OneStream/HFM, D365/SAP/Oracle or similar)

• Experience with and/or interest in leveraging AI to improve reporting, analysis, and ways of working

• Experience in the logistics sector and project management is a plus, but not required

A degree in finance, economics, business administration, or similar is expected. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

We think the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills, and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

**Working at DFDS

****Join the movement and grow with us

**As part of the Logistics Division - a business that has tripled in size over recent years - you will be at the heart of major strategic transformation as the division works to develop its network and digitise a traditionally manual industry.

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

**Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply now.

**If you think your personality, skills, and experience match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Jens Beck, Head of Logistics Finance Business Partnering, Central, at jenbeck@dfds.com.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.occupation: Project Director - Energy Infrastructure, Energy Security & Critical Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Do you want to lead infrastructure projects that power and protect Europe’s future? Do you have the experience, leadership skills and commercial mindset needed to deliver some of Europe’s most strategic energy infrastructure projects? And can you lead multidisciplinary teams? Then, come join COWI!  **Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**At COWI, we help our clients address some of society’s most important challenges.

The energy landscape is changing rapidly. Europe is investing in resilient energy infrastructure, decarbonisation, critical infrastructure and strategic energy systems that strengthen security of supply and societal resilience.

To support this development, we are looking for an experienced Project Director to join our Green Energy infrastructure team in Lyngby.

You will become part of our engineering environment working with:

• Hydrogen infrastructure

• CO₂ transportation and storage

• Gas transmission systems

• LNG and ammonia terminals

• Energy storage facilities

• Critical infrastructure

• Defence-related energy infrastructure

• NATO Pipeline System (NPS) developments

• Energy Security & Resilience

You should bring a strong technical foundation and solid experience within one or more of the above, however we are not looking for an expert in all the areas. But we need you to understand complex engineering challenges and provide qualified technical sparring across multidisciplinary teams.

**Drive projects from strategy to implementation

**A significant part of our project portfolio originates in the early project phases, where clients define future investments and establish the technical and commercial foundations for large infrastructure projects.

As Project Director, you will play a key role in guiding clients through feasibility assessments, concept development, Pre-FEED and FEED phases, before supporting implementation through detailed design and Owner’s Engineer assignments.

You will be responsible for leading multidisciplinary teams across Denmark and our international delivery centres while ensuring technical quality, commercial performance and strong client relationships.

Your key responsibilities

• Lead large and complex multidisciplinary energy infrastructure projects.

• Act as Project Director on feasibility studies, Pre-FEED, FEED, detailed design and Owner’s Engineer assignments.

• Support clients in defining and developing future energy infrastructure investments.

• Develop trusted long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders.

• Drive commercial performance, governance and project risk management.

• Lead international and multidisciplinary project teams.

• Support business development and major proposal activities.

• Mentor and develop project managers and technical specialists.

• Contribute to COWI’s growth within Energy Security, Resilience and Critical Infrastructure.

• Support emerging opportunities within defence-related energy infrastructure and NATO Pipeline System projects.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.**We are looking for a highly experienced project leader who combines solid technical understanding with strong project execution capabilities.

On top of that, you will have:

• 15+ years of experience from multidisciplinary engineering and project management.

• A strong technical background and in-depth experience within one or more areas such as pipelines systems, terminals, process facilities or other energy infrastructure.

• The technical understanding needed to engage with specialists, challenge technical solutions and lead multidisciplinary engineering teams.

• Experience from feasibility studies, Pre-FEED, FEED, detailed design and/or Owner’s Engineer assignments.

• Strong commercial understanding and contract management experience.

• Experience managing large projects and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

• Experience working in international project environments.

• A relevant engineering degree.

A place to work and so much moreAt COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Peter Malmkjær, Head of Projects, Green Energy Pipelines at PRMR@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you applyAll you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employerCOWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Spirii is looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer.

If you are passionate about cloud software development, team collaboration, and creating outstanding backend code, join Spirii's fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working, including how we adopt AI to raise the quality and speed of our engineering.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer in our Payments team within the Engineering department, you will help enhance the backbone of the Spirii platform that turns charging data into accurate invoices, credit memos, and payouts. It's a domain where correctness and financial data integrity are non-negotiable. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with CPH and near-shore colleagues, as well as Finance and partner teams.

What You Will Do

Together with your team, you will be responsible for:

• 
Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure backend services and cloud-native queue-based pipelines (Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript) that power data ingestion, processing, and invoice generation at high throughput.

• 
Ensuring data quality through correct aggregation and safe handling of late or updated records.

• 
Building and maintaining integrations with internal services and our ERP system.

• 
Significantly contributing to architectural decisions and solution design for cloud-native, distributed, event-driven systems on AWS.

• 
Driving automated testing and observability to protect billing correctness and catch data discrepancies early.

• 
Mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar of the team through code review, pairing, and constructive feedback.

• 
Operating independently on ambiguous, cross-team problems with minimal oversight.

• 
Using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate development and automate repetitive tasks while helping the team adopt AI safely in a financially sensitive codebase.

Who You Are

• 
Like to explore innovative technologies, including AI tools and agentic workflows, and continuously expand your skills.

• 
Ambitious and execution-focused, with strong ability to balance functional and non-functional requirements when designing solutions.

• 
A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex backend systems and actively maintaining operational awareness.

• 
Skilled at breaking down complex, ambiguous initiatives into vertical slices that deliver value incrementally; you default to shipping in small, regular batches rather than big-bang releases.

• 
Comfortable working in Agile, cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, Finance, partners), and an active participant in creating an open, collaborative environment.

• 
Excellent English communication skills and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization, internally and externally with partners/customers.

Qualifications

• 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 
7+ years of professional software development experience.

• 
Extensive hands-on experience designing and scaling production backend systems, including having designed event-driven, queue/job-based architectures.

• 
Strong experience building TypeScript or JavaScript (Node.js, NestJS) microservices on cloud platforms such as AWS.

• 
Experience leading design discussions, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical point of contact for a team or domain.

• 
Hands-on experience with test-driven development, test automation, integration and load testing.

• 
Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with the discipline needed for financially accurate, auditable data.

• 
Experience integrating external and internal IT systems, and solid API design.

• 
Experience with developing secure software is a plus.

• 
Knowledge of Redis and NoSQL databases is an advantage.

• 
Experience working with or integrating ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central) is an advantage.

• 
Experience with billing, payments, invoicing, or other financial/transactional systems is a strong plus.

• 
Hands-on experience using AI assistants and/or agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity is a plus.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: Data Engineer - Design, build and scale the foundations of data and AI
jobs.description:
**Location: Copenhagen (please note this job requires onsite presence - remote work not possible)

**Do you want to work hands-on with modern cloud-based technologies, data engineering and AI, while helping turn complex data into solutions that create real business value?

Join us as a Data Engineer to become part of an environment where knowledge is shared, and curiosity is encouraged. And work with tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Claude, Microsoft Azure, SQL and AI as you help develop the data platform that enables actionable insights, intelligent solutions and data-driven applications.

“You’ll get to contribute to solutions for a wide portfolio of customers - without compromising on flexibility and work-life balance. This also allows you to develop your expertise through challenging assignments and collaboration with experienced colleagues,” says Brian Landbo, Manager, SmartX.

**Join an environment built around knowledge, collaboration and growth

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe that development happens when people learn and solve challenges together. You will become part of our ambitious and agile SmartX team where the pace is high and where we work with modern cloud technologies, data engineering, analytics and AI through our data platform.

**Develop our cloud-based data platform

**As a Data Engineer, you will work closely with analysts, developers and business stakeholders, play a central role in developing our cloud-based data platform, and help transform complex data requirements into robust solutions that deliver real value. You will work across data engineering and AI, while contributing to the foundations that make intelligent and data-driven solutions possible.

**More Specifically, You Will

**

• Develop and maintain data models

• Develop, optimize and quality-assure data pipelines in Snowflake

• Implement transformations, tests and documentation using dbt

• Ensure high data quality through automated testing and validation processes

• Work with Medallion Architecture and modern data warehouse principles

• Support the development of AI-based solutions and data-driven applications

**Experience With The Main Technologies

**You do not need to tick every box. We believe some of the best colleagues grow through curiosity, commitment and a genuine desire to learn. We are looking for a new colleague who enjoys solving complex problems and who is motivated by both technology and the value it can create. You thrive in a collaborative environment where professional dialogue and knowledge sharing are an important part of everyday work. And you enjoy continuously learning and exploring new technologies within data, AI and cloud platforms.

**Finally, We Imagine That You

**

• Have hands-on experience with and a solid understanding of Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse

• Have strong SQL and data modelling skills, including experience with dimensional modelling such as facts, dimensions and star schemas

• Have experience using dbt for data transformation and ETL/ELT processes

• Have worked with data validation, automated testing and documentation

• Have experience with Git and agile development processes

**Ready to build what comes next?

**Then we are happy to hear from you and urge you to hit that “Apply Now“ button.

Apply today and make NTT DATA Business Solutions the place where you grow.

**Job Description

**Do you want to lead a team of six and shape the future of data and analytics in Danica? As Head of Business Data & Analytics, you will develop people, set direction and strengthen the link between data, insights and business value.

Your team works across business and data analytics, partnering with the business and management to turn complex challenges into actionable insights and data-driven solutions. Data is a key enabler of Danica’s strategy: your work will support better decisions, customer experiences, business performance and growth. This role combines people leadership with a strong interest in data and business, helping the team and wider organisation strengthen their use of analytics as our capabilities evolve.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will strengthen analytical maturity and continuously develop our data and analytics capabilities. As our new data platform evolves, you will leverage opportunities enabled by the platform, AI and other emerging technologies to improve how we generate insights and turn data into tangible business value.

Your team will be a trusted business analytics partner to stakeholders across Danica, providing insights that enhance business decisions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop a team of six, helping them turn data and analysis into actionable business insights.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Danica, acting as a trusted analytics partner while providing credible professional challenge.

• Continuously develop the team's analytical capabilities, methods and ways of working, fostering a strong analytical mindset and high professional standards.

• Collaborate with the leadership team in Data & Analytics to set direction, align priorities and strengthen how data and analytics create value across Danica.

**About You

**We imagine that you are an experienced people leader with a strong background in analytics, data or a closely related field. You do not necessarily need to be the deepest technical specialist in the team, but you should have sufficient analytical understanding to challenge, guide and develop the team.

• People leadership. You have demonstrated leadership experience and enjoy developing people. You lead with trust, curiosity and a collaborative mindset.

• Analytical expertise. You bring strong analytical expertise and act as a trusted sparring partner for the team.

• Business understanding. You understand how business questions can be translated into data use cases, analysis and actionable insights.

• Direction and delivery. You are able to set direction while balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery.

• Stakeholder relationships and communication. You build strong stakeholder relationships and are comfortable constructively challenging established thinking. You communicate complex topics clearly and confidently across technical and non-technical audiences.

It is required that you are fluent in both Danish and English !

**What We Offer You

**

• Influence and impact. Shape the future of Business Data & Analytics in an area where data increasingly drives business development and decisions. Develop the team’s analytical competencies and influence how new data capabilities create business value across Danica.

• Leadership development. Genuine opportunities to develop your own leadership capabilities.

• Hybrid working. Hybrid working arrangements, typically three days per week in the office.

Interested**?

**Apply today! If you have any questions about the position, please reach out to the Head of Data & Analytics Thomas Jonsson at thjon@danica.dk . We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply at your earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Technician – Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced downstream technician with hands-on knowledge of chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes? Do you enjoy working independently while sharing your expertise with colleagues?

**At AGC Biologics, we are looking for a Senior Technician to join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team in Copenhagen.

You will work in a dynamic, GMP-regulated manufacturing environment where different products and customer requirements call for technical expertise, adaptability, and attention to detail. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable production while helping strengthen the technical capabilities of your colleagues.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Technician, you will be responsible for executing downstream purification processes and ensuring that manufacturing activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP requirements.

You will work independently within your area of expertise while collaborating with colleagues to meet production goals. The role requires strong process understanding, sound judgement, and the ability to adapt to different manufacturing setups without compromising quality.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Executing downstream purification processes, including chromatography, filtration, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Operating chromatography systems, including UNICORN software, and applying your technical understanding during production.

• Ensuring accurate GMP documentation and compliance with approved procedures and aseptic practices.

• Supporting troubleshooting, deviation investigations, and continuous improvement activities.

• Taking ownership of your training, technical qualifications, and development.

• Sharing knowledge and providing hands-on training and guidance to less experienced colleagues.

As you become familiar with our processes, we expect you to take an active role in supporting the development of new colleagues and contributing to high standards of technical performance and GMP behaviour within the team.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced technician with a solid understanding of downstream purification and a strong commitment to quality and compliance.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Have approximately 3–5 years of experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, preferably within biopharmaceutical production.

• Have an educational background as a Process Operator, Industrial Technician, Biotechnology Technician, or an equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Have hands-on experience with chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes.

• Have a good understanding of UNICORN chromatography systems.

• Are familiar with GMP requirements, aseptic practices, and accurate production documentation.

• Can independently execute complex manufacturing activities and contribute to solving technical challenges.

Beyond your technical experience, we value colleagues who take ownership of their work and development, maintain high standards of quality, and contribute positively to the team.

You work in a structured way, adapt to changing production needs, and willingly share your knowledge. You communicate openly and understand when to ask for support or escalate an issue rather than compromise quality or compliance.

**Working Hours

**This is a night-shift position (18:00-05:04 or 20:00-07:04) in our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing department in Copenhagen.

You will work according to an established shift schedule (5-2 in a 14 days period) supporting our manufacturing operations.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will join an international biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment where technical expertise, accountability, quality, and teamwork are central to how we work.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to work with different products and downstream manufacturing setups, developing your technical expertise.

• A role where your experience matters, both in daily production and in supporting the development of your colleagues.

• A supportive and approachable manager who values trust, accountability, and open communication.

• A collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are encouraged.

• We offer an attractive compensation and benefits package, including pension, health insurance, and other benefits in accordance with local agreements.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**Interested?

**If you have experience with downstream purification and are motivated by combining technical responsibility with quality and teamwork, we would like to hear from you.

Interested?

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

**Apply today and join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team at AGC Biologics.

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Opoint is looking to add another talented individual to our BDR team and continue our growth!

Opoint is an industry-leading technology firm based in the Nordics and the UK. We specialise in the capture and delivery of content from over +250,000 news data sources across 135 languages and 220 jurisdictions.

Opoint’s global customer base spans many sectors, including finance, media, consulting, risk management, regulatory and compliance workflows.

Are you a door opener, a network builder and someone who enjoys engaging with prospects? Then this role is for you.

Job Description

This is an application round for a Business Development Representative (BDR) based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

We are seeking an extroverted, results-oriented BDR to communicate with global prospects across outreach channels (cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn).

You will focus on opening doors, starting relationships with international companies, and connecting them with Account Executives.

As part of Opoint’s Sales and Marketing team, you’ll have excellent opportunities to grow your career on an international and commercial track across a range of industries. You’ll build fluency in the risks and needs of each sector and engage directly with decision makers. Expect flexibility in your routine and no two days alike.

What You Do

• Work with an Account Executive Team to execute outreach strategies to engage multinational companies across various industries and markets.

• Operate in international markets, sharpening your pitching and problem-solving skills as you evaluate and match client needs to the right solution.

• Reach monthly outreach targets with the help of your team.

The Skill Set You Bring

• Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field (Business, Economics); other degree types and relevant work experience will be considered.

• Relevant B-2-B sales experience preferred; internship experience taken into consideration.

• Ability to learn and understand data products and technology, required.

• Interest in the technology sales industry as a career path, required.

• Previous cold-calling experience, preferred.

• Experience with lead generation tools, considered a plus.

• Results-driven & competitive nature.

• Interest in exchanging verbally with new prospects and cold calling, required.

• Fluency in written and oral English is a requirement.

• Commitment to becoming a closing SaaS Account Executive, considered a plus.

• Must hold a valid working visa for Denmark.

What We Offer

• An exciting position in an international environment and ability to grow a career at the intersection of technology and business development.

• The opportunity to engage with different companies in different industries around the world.

• A fun and relaxed work environment that prioritises teamwork, communication, and flexibility while executing goals.

• A great group of colleagues in Opoint and throughout the wider ownership group.

• Flexible working hours.

• Social activities, including social clubs, sports, seasonal parties, and company events.

• Canteen arrangement.

• A premier office space at Pilestræde 58 in central Copenhagen.

Interested?

This is a full-time position, and we are looking for candidates who can start soon.

We look forward to reading your application and CV. Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. Therefore, kindly refrain from including documents containing personal identification numbers (CPR numbers).

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Toby Cook (toby.cook@opoint.com) or Henrik Dragland (henrik.o.dragland@opoint.com) or +45 31712831 to learn more.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply for the position regardless of age, gender, religion, or ethnic background.

At Ambu, we’re developing next-generation single-use endoscopes, and we’re looking for skilled mechanical engineers to help design the small, precise systems that make these devices work.

**This position can be based in either Ballerup, Denmark or Augsburg, Germany.

**In this role, you’ll take a leading part in developing the miniature mechanical assemblies at the heart of our endoscope platforms. It’s a chance to solve real-world engineering challenges, working with ultra-compact designs, new technologies and materials, smart material choices, and high-volume manufacturing to deliver reliable products used in clinical care around the world.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Mechanical Engineer in the Camera Engineering Team, you will own the mechanical design of Ambu’s next-generation camera modules and assemblies - from early exploration to full-scale production. Your work will directly impact the performance of our products in critical care settings.

**You Can Expect To

**

• Lead mechanical development from proof of concept to validated designs, ensuring robust, compact, and cost-effective solutions.

• Design miniaturized mechanical systems that integrate tightly with optics, electronics, and high-precision molded plastic parts with complex geometries.

• Select materials and processes based on functional requirements, tolerances, mechanical stress, and compatibility with injection molding, 3D printing, or automated assembly.

• Solve complex engineering problems related to thermal management, alignment of optical and imaging elements, sealing against moisture ingress, and the mechanical packaging of delicate electronics.

• Translate clinical and usability needs into clear, feasible mechanical specifications by collaborating with physicians, designers, and R&D teams.

• Create working prototypes for concept validation and manufacturability testing using methods such as 3D printing, machining, and early tool trials.

• Optimize designs for scalable, high-yield manufacturing, including tolerance stack-up, DFMA, and robust design principles.

• Collaborate across functions and locations, including development teams in Denmark, Germany, and Malaysia, as well as global suppliers and technology partners.

**Qualifications

**We believe the best candidates blend creative engineering, hands-on experience, and the ability to see products through from idea to production.

You are likely to thrive in this role if you have:

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field.

• Experience in mechanical design ideally for compact or precision-engineered systems.

• A hands-on approach to prototyping, testing, and iterating designs. Experience with a range of 3D printing technologies is a plus.

• Experience designing plastic parts and compact assemblies for high-volume manufacturing using processes such as injection molding or overmolding.

• A good understanding of how material properties (e.g. processability, chemical resistance, thermal behavior) impact product function and process choices.

• Familiarity with integrating miniature electronic components or camera modules into complex mechanical encapsulations.

• Strong 3D CAD skills (e.g. Creo, SolidWorks, Inventor, or Catia).

• Strong collaboration and communication skills across technical disciplines.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

**Why Join Ambu?

**Ambu is a fast-growing, international MedTech company with a clear mission: to improve patient care while advancing medical technology. We combine agility with global reach, and you’ll have the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where your decisions and designs directly influence clinical outcomes.

**Only applications recieved in English will be considered.

****We Offer

**

• Meaningful technical challenges and product ownership.

• Cross-disciplinary teams with passionate, skilled colleagues.

• Personal and professional development opportunities.

• A flexible, people-first culture with global collaboration.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal and professional development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges.
